title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed mixed-methods analysis of transportation app user interviews. Key findings: 1) Quantitative analysis showed equal cohort distribution (9 transit, 9 car), average 19.9 words per response, with top keywords 'app' (6), 'time' (3), 'train' (3). 2) LLM-assisted thematic analysis identified 4 themes per cohort: transit users emphasized reliability (44%), safety (33%), information transparency (44%), multimodal integration (22%); car users focused on cost comparison (33%), parking integration (33%), interface simplicity (22%), multimodal planning (22%). 3) Comparative analysis revealed overlapping concerns about multimodal integration and information transparency, with cohort-specific differences in reliability vs. cost focus. 4) Generated 6 visualizations and comprehensive reports with 5 design implications for transportation app improvement. All deliverables completed including code, outputs, and reports.
